message: Initial website — HTML & CSS portfolio with hero, about, projects, photography, CV and contact sections
n8n-inspired dark redesign — deep navy theme, orange accents, Inter font, dark cards, two-column CV layout
Site Evolution page — interactive Gitgraph.js branch visualisation, standalone evolution.html, version history cards with GitHub diff links
Photography portfolio — full masonry gallery, lightbox, EXIF-sorted thumbnails and per-image downloads
Finance-focused reinvention — repositioned hero, impact metrics, skills, experience timeline, particle canvas, scroll animations and a proper mobile nav
